title: Center and Periphery
grammar: Directional asymmetry and vertical metaphors in geography (fel a fővárosba vs. le a vidékre)
goal: I can use conventional Hungarian directional preverbs (fel/le, ki/be) to contrast capital and provinces
I can analyze center-periphery dynamics in regional development and demographic movement
I can navigate colloquial and literary directional idioms regarding rural vs. urban life
